summary: CTT Pharmaceutical Holdings filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026, reporting the addition of Karen Larson as an independent board member, effective around the August 10, 2026 report date. Larson is a Certified Financial Planner who founded an analytical reporting business sold to Morningstar, served as a Senior Vice President and investment banker at Chase Manhattan Bank, and since 2017 has led Broad Avenue Studios, a commercial and residential real estate firm. No shareholder vote, advisor, compensation terms, price, or ownership stake was disclosed. The appointment expands board oversight at the OTCQB-listed microcap; watch for further governance or strategic changes.
